title: How I measure growth as a designer
content: In a public LinkedIn post, Quadri reflected that design growth is not only about making screens look more polished. He described growth in organizing files faster, thinking more critically about design decisions, conducting better user research, and structuring design systems more efficiently. This is a useful signal of his professional perspective, not a formal methodology or a claim about a specific client project.
